summary_1line: Philosophical discourse linking life-winds, sacrifice symbolism, sensory faculties, and the inner Self, portraying yoga and knowledge as an internal sacrificial path to emancipation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Within a meditating sage’s body, a glowing inner fire receives streams of offerings from the senses while the life-winds swirl around it.
Prana rising and Apana descending like two currents around a central flame inside a human form.
Deities, rishis, snakes, and asuras sit before the Lord of creatures as he utters the single syllable Om.
